name: Quick Pill 5.5.7
changelog: Polish: The notch reacts much faster again - the hover settle time is down to 20 ms and the notch collapses 90 ms after the cursor leaves instead of 140/280 ms, while the anti-flicker protection stays in place.
Polish: The native cursor hit-test now polls every 30 ms instead of 50 ms, so the notch opens a few milliseconds sooner.
